away.summary: The Capitals open the season 0-0-0 with Alex Ovechkin confirmed to play after missing the preseason with a lower-body injury. They project Logan Thompson to start in goal, with Charlie Lindgren as backup. Key scratches include Ivan Miroshnichenko, Ethen Frank, and Dylan McIlrath, while Rasmus Sandin is out with a knee injury.

home.summary: The Hurricanes open 0-0-1 after a 1-0 overtime loss to the Florida Panthers in their season opener. They project Brandon Bussi to start in goal, with Pyotr Kochetkov as backup. The team will dress the same lineup used in the opener, with Seth Jarvis out (shoulder) and Jesperi Kotkaniemi and Mike Reilly scratched.
